## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (lint, tests, build, performance budget)
- [ ] I only touched files my lane owns (or I tagged the owner)
- [ ] No data shape, screen list or UX rule changed. If one did: this PR is labelled `contract` and all four of us approved it
- [ ] **CLAUDE.md is updated** if I changed a shape, screen, rule, command, the layout, or the "State of the repo" block (CI checks the parts it can)
- [ ] No secrets, no hand-edited `app/public/data/*.json`, nothing from `walks/` loaded on the first screen
- [ ] Screenshot attached for any UI change
- [ ] No AI co-author trailers or "Generated with" lines in the commits or this description (CLAUDE.md rule 6)
